note: Pottawattamie County Conservation Board park outside Hancock on Hwy G-30, on the West Nishnabotna River Water Trail, known for its bison and elk herds. Three camping areas: South (grass pads with the river view, beside the water trail access), Middle (concrete pads, showers) and North (grass). --Claude
summary: County rates and FCFS confirmed; count 40->56; high $20->$30; added water, sewer, 50-amp, Wi-Fi, FCFS. Pin in town 330 m off. Riverview lead for South Campground.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD, stored 'not waterfront' looks too low; the stored evidence ('RV loops ~100-150 m back behind continuous treeline') describes the Middle loop only. County page on the South Campground (16 sites): 'This camping area has a great view of the West Nishnabotna River'. Esri z18 leaf-off at 41.3915,-95.3695: South's west row of pads about 20-30 m from the bank, river about 45 m wide, with the campground's own loop road between pads and water. Loop road rules out riverfront, so riverview for South. Middle stays behind the wooded bank (z17: the loop's north end about 50 m from the river through trees); North was not looked at closely.

PIN: stored 41.39227,-95.36487 is on the ball field in town beside the grain elevator, no sites there. South Campground centre 41.3913,-95.3686 (about 330 m off; the one carrying the river view); Middle Campground centre 41.3958,-95.3651 (about 400 m off), both seen on imagery and the 2026 park map. I'd pin South, because the water value belongs to it.

Mycountyparks page is stale against the county's own: 'forty 30 amp' and only '$20'. The county page is what was recorded. County page names site counts per area; which sites carry water or sewer isn't stated.
